title: Zesty, Juicy, Fresh Middle Eastern Cucumbers Warak Enab (Pickled Cucumbers in a Jar)
description: A flavorful and refreshing Middle Eastern dish made with pickled cucumbers, featuring a unique twist from Thai green curry paste. Perfect for hot summer days or as a crunchy snack.
instructions: Wash and dry the cucumbers thoroughly, removing any seeds or blemishes.
In a medium saucepan, combine the red wine vinegar, water, green curry paste, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat, whisking constantly.
Reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for 5 minutes.
Pack the sliced cucumbers into a clean 1-quart mason jar, leaving about 1 inch of space at the top.
Pour the hot pickling liquid over the cucumbers, making sure they are completely covered.
Seal the jar and let it cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate the jar for at least 2 hours or overnight before serving.
Just before serving, garnish with chopped fresh dill.
